$description: Semantic colors over the generated scales in palette.json. A value is either one reference used in both modes ("{neutral.12}") or { light, dark }. References are scale steps ({accent.9}), theme key colors ({key.onAccent}), black / white, optionally with alpha percent ({key.foreground/5}). Roles follow the web token rules (lody-oss/packages/ui/src/tokens/RULES.md): ink, not accent, fills primary buttons; accent marks focus, links, on / checked state and the running indicator.

base.$description: Screen background for plain lists and content (web: background).

grouped.$description: Behind grouped lists and cards (web: secondaryBackground in light).

sunken.$description: Text fields and wells: a translucent darkening of whatever they sit on (web: wellBackground).

overlay.$description: Menus, popovers, toasts' surface; pair with an elevation (web: raisedBackground).

inverse.$description: Tooltips and inverse toasts; text uses text.inverse.

pressed.$description: Row / cell highlight while pressed (web: hoverFill). Android uses ripple.

selected.$description: Persistently selected row, chip or segment (web: selectedFill).

secondary.$description: Secondary buttons, neutral chips, segmented track (web: trayBackground).

default.$description: Primary button fill and the send button (web: label fill).

on.$description: Text and icons on ink (web: background).

tertiary.$description: Section headers, timestamps. One step stronger than the web's tertiaryLabel so short text keeps 3:1.

onAccent.$description: On accent.default: white in light, black on the dark theme's orange.

tertiary.$description: Decorative only, e.g. the section header plus.

default.$description: Outlines where no well or shadow fits (filter chips).

accent.$description: Key color: hsl(220 82% 65%) light, Vesper orange hsl(27 100% 80%) dark. Not a button fill.

default.$description: Switch on, checked, progress, selection, running indicator.

fg.$description: Accent as readable foreground: selected tab, active icon, links.

subtle.$description: Tinted background for accent chips and banners.

warning.$description: Reports an outcome; marks and tints, never fills a pressable control.

default.$description: The light key (hsl(32 90% 48%)) is under 3:1 on white, so light icons use the text step.

success.$description: Reports an outcome; marks and tints, never fills a pressable control.

info.$description: The web has no info role; neutral notices use the accent scale.

state.$description: Session status glyphs. Running uses accent, as on the web. Shape carries meaning too; color is never the only signal.

label.$description: Categorical colors for project labels, tags and avatar backgrounds; hues generated to sit in the theme. fg reads on bg.base and on the matching bg.

syntax.$description: Syntax highlighting on code.bg, drawn from the categorical scales so it follows the theme.

constant.$description: true / false / null and named constants.

shadow.$description: Shadow ink per elevation level (tokens/elevation.json). Zero saturation, as on the web; much stronger in dark mode.
